tools.name: list_preparation_drafts
tools.description: List the signed-in user's AusTax preparation checklists. These are organisation-only checklists, not tax advice and cannot lodge a return.
tools.sql: SELECT id, income_year, residency, income_salary_wages, income_bank_interest, income_dividends, income_rental, income_sole_trader, income_shares_crypto, income_foreign, income_government_payments, deduction_work_from_home, deduction_work_related, deduction_work_travel, deduction_self_education, deduction_donations, deduction_tax_affairs, consideration_private_health, consideration_help_loan, consideration_rental_property, consideration_investments, consideration_foreign_residency, consideration_business_income, record_status, created_at, updated_at FROM return_drafts WHERE user_id = :__user_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT :limit

limit.description: Maximum number of preparation drafts to return

tools.name: get_preparation_draft
tools.description: Get one signed-in user's AusTax preparation checklist by ID. It contains only predefined checklist selections, not tax identifiers, documents, credentials, calculations, or lodging data.
tools.sql: SELECT id, income_year, residency, income_salary_wages, income_bank_interest, income_dividends, income_rental, income_sole_trader, income_shares_crypto, income_foreign, income_government_payments, deduction_work_from_home, deduction_work_related, deduction_work_travel, deduction_self_education, deduction_donations, deduction_tax_affairs, consideration_private_health, consideration_help_loan, consideration_rental_property, consideration_investments, consideration_foreign_residency, consideration_business_income, record_status, created_at, updated_at FROM return_drafts WHERE id = :draft_id AND user_id = :__user_id LIMIT 1

tools.name: save_preparation_draft
tools.description: Create or update the signed-in user's predefined AusTax preparation checklist. Do not use this tool for TFNs, bank details, credentials, identity documents, tax calculations, personal tax advice, or lodging.
tools.sql: INSERT INTO return_drafts (id, user_id, income_year, residency, income_salary_wages, income_bank_interest, income_dividends, income_rental, income_sole_trader, income_shares_crypto, income_foreign, income_government_payments, deduction_work_from_home, deduction_work_related, deduction_work_travel, deduction_self_education, deduction_donations, deduction_tax_affairs, consideration_private_health, consideration_help_loan, consideration_rental_property, consideration_investments, consideration_foreign_residency, consideration_business_income, record_status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT :draft_id, :__user_id, :income_year, :residency, :income_salary_wages, :income_bank_interest, :income_dividends, :income_rental, :income_sole_trader, :income_shares_crypto, :income_foreign, :income_government_payments, :deduction_work_from_home, :deduction_work_related, :deduction_work_travel, :deduction_self_education, :deduction_donations, :deduction_tax_affairs, :consideration_private_health, :consideration_help_loan, :consideration_rental_property, :consideration_investments, :consideration_foreign_residency, :consideration_business_income, :record_status, :__now, :__now WHERE length(:draft_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128 AND :income_year GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]' AND :residency IN ('Yes', 'No', 'Not sure') AND :record_status IN ('Ready to review', 'Some to find', 'Not sure') ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET income_year = excluded.income_year, residency = excluded.residency, income_salary_wages = excluded.income_salary_wages, income_bank_interest = excluded.income_bank_interest, income_dividends = excluded.income_dividends, income_rental = excluded.income_rental, income_sole_trader = excluded.income_sole_trader, income_shares_crypto = excluded.income_shares_crypto, income_foreign = excluded.income_foreign, income_government_payments = excluded.income_government_payments, deduction_work_from_home = excluded.deduction_work_from_home, deduction_work_related = excluded.deduction_work_related, deduction_work_travel = excluded.deduction_work_travel, deduction_self_education = excluded.deduction_self_education, deduction_donations = excluded.deduction_donations, deduction_tax_affairs = excluded.deduction_tax_affairs, consideration_private_health = excluded.consideration_private_health, consideration_help_loan = excluded.consideration_help_loan, consideration_rental_property = excluded.consideration_rental_property, consideration_investments = excluded.consideration_investments, consideration_foreign_residency = excluded.consideration_foreign_residency, consideration_business_income = excluded.consideration_business_income, record_status = excluded.record_status, updated_at = :__now WHERE return_drafts.user_id = :__user_id

income_year.description: Australian income year in YYYY-YY form

residency.description: One of Yes, No, or Not sure

record_status.description: One of Ready to review, Some to find, or Not sure

tools.name: delete_preparation_draft
tools.description: Delete one signed-in user's AusTax preparation checklist. This never lodges or changes an ATO return.
tools.sql: DELETE FROM return_drafts WHERE id = :draft_id AND user_id = :__user_id
